MAKE DOC: Weekly Safety Checklist for Small Workshop
## Weekly Safety Checklist
- [ ] All electrical cords are unplugged and stored safely.
- [ ] Fire extinguishers are inspected and charged.
- [ ] First aid kit is stocked and accessible.
- [ ] Emergency exit routes are clear of clutter.
- [ ] Locks on storage areas are functional.
- [ ] PPE (gloves, goggles, hearing protection) is available.
- [ ] Ventilation fans are operational.
- [ ] No unauthorized modifications to machinery.
- [ ] All tools are stored in designated racks.
- [ ] Floor is free of oil, grease, and debris.
- [ ] Emergency contact numbers are posted.
- [ ] Daily safety briefing was conducted.
- [ ] No open flames or sparks were observed.
- [ ] All personnel signed off on the checklist.
- [ ] Next week's safety plan was reviewed.
- [ ] Hazard report was filed if any issues were found.
- [ ] Maintenance schedule was followed.
- [ ] No unauthorized personnel entered the workspace.
- [ ] All equipment was tested and verified safe.
- [ ] Waste disposal bins were emptied and secured.
- [ ] No unauthorized modifications to machinery.
- [ ] All tools were stored in designated racks.
- [ ] Floor was free of oil, grease, and debris.
- [ ] Emergency contact numbers were posted.
- [ ] Daily safety briefing was conducted.
- [ ] No open flames or sparks were observed.
- [ ] All personnel signed off on the checklist.
- [ ] Next week's safety plan was reviewed.

MAKE WHEEL: Ohm's Law Power Wheel
<part>: P = V * I | P = V^2 / R | P = I^2 * R fill red
<part>: V = P / I | V = sqrt(P * R) | V = I * R fill orange
<part>: I = P / V | I = sqrt(P * V) | I = V / R fill yellow
<part>: R = P / I | R = V^2 / P | R = V * I fill green
note Ohm's Law formulas

From my own knowledge: The formulas in your original wheel were incorrect because they did not follow the standard Ohm's Law relationships. The correct relationships are:
1. $P = V \times I$ (Power equals Voltage times Current)
2. $P = V^2 / R$ (Power equals Voltage squared divided by Resistance)
3. $P = I^2 \times R$ (Power equals Current squared times Resistance)
4. $V = P / I$ (Voltage equals Power divided by Current)
5. $V = \sqrt{P \times R}$ (Voltage equals the square root of Power times Resistance)
6. $V = I \times R$ (Voltage equals Current times Resistance)

The original wheel had errors like $I = \sqrt{P \times V}$, which is incorrect. The correct formula for Current is $I = P / V$ or $I = \sqrt{P / R}$, not $\sqrt{P \times V}$. The original wheel also had $R = P / I$, which is incorrect; the correct formula is $R = P / I^2$ or $R = V^2 / P$. The original wheel also had $R = V \times I$, which is incorrect; the correct formula is $R = V / I$.

Corrected formulas for the wheel:
- Part 1 (P): $P = V \times I$ | $P = V^2 / R$ | $P = I^2 \times R$
- Part 2 (V): $V = P / I$ | $V = \sqrt{P \times R}$ | $V = I \times R$
- Part 3 (I): $I = P / V$ | $I = \sqrt{P / R}$ | $I = V / R$
